name: Pittsboro
seo_title: Pittsboro Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Pittsboro, North Carolina for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Pittsboro celebrates Christmas with a drone show at MOSAIC, holiday evenings at Fearrington Village and a town parade down East Street.
celebrates: Chatham Park hosts Brightspeed's Merry + Bright Christmas Drone Light Show at MOSAIC on December 5, with a holiday market of more than 30 vendors, a free photo with Santa and the Christmas Train. Fearrington Village lights its Beltie on December 4 with carolers and refreshments and serves Tea with Santa on December 6. The Town of Pittsboro holds its free Christmas Parade on East Street on December 13 and the last of the four events in this guide. Families with young children can pair the December 4 Beltie lighting with the December 5 drone show on one weekend.
lastyear: This guide could not confirm last year's details for these events from the hosts' pages, so it lists only what the 2026 pages print. The Town of Pittsboro's permit and parade page list different start times for the December 13 parade, so arrive early. Pittsboro's Holly Days on November 22 has already passed, which is why it is not listed here.
facts: MOSAIC is at 457 Freedom Parkway, where the drone show begins at 7 pm. Fearrington Village is at 240 Market Street, and its Tea with Santa is held on The Garden Terrace, 1:30 to 3:30 pm, at $125 per person on the visitors calendar. The parade follows East Street, US 64 Business, from Martin Luther King Jr. Drive through downtown Pittsboro.
trains: Pittsboro has no train ride of its own, but the MOSAIC drone show lists a Christmas Train among its free activities. The closest family train outing we have verified is the North Carolina Transportation Museum in Spencer, in Rowan County, which offers 25-minute train rides. Our Raleigh guide covers the New Hope Valley Railway Santa Express for families who want a longer holiday train trip.
train_links: Admission from $10, or $20 with a 25-minute train ride, at the old Spencer Shops in Spencer.
traditions: A free drone show at 7 pm with a holiday market, Santa photos and the Christmas Train.
Carolers, refreshments and a countdown to the illuminated Beltie at Fearrington Village.
A seated tea with storytime, Santa and Mrs. Claus at The Garden Terrace.
A parade along East Street from Martin Luther King Jr. Drive on December 13.
kidfact: The MOSAIC holiday evening lists a Christmas Train and appearances by the snow sisters.
faq: What Christmas events can kids enjoy in Pittsboro?

Families can watch the drone light show at MOSAIC, see the Beltie lit at Fearrington Village, take Tea with Santa or watch the Pittsboro Christmas Parade. Each listing links to the host's page for dates, times and ticket rules, and two of the four are free.
Is the Pittsboro Christmas parade free?

Yes. The Pittsboro Christmas Parade is free to watch. It runs Sunday, December 13, 2026, along East Street from Martin Luther King Jr. Drive. The town page lists 3 to 5 pm, while the permit lists 2 to 5 pm, so arrive early.
Is the Pittsboro drone light show free?

Yes. Brightspeed's Merry + Bright Christmas Drone Light Show is free with a $0 ticket claimed through Eventeny. The event runs 6 to 8 pm on December 5 at MOSAIC, and the drones fly at 7 pm, so register early for a $0 ticket.
Where can children meet Santa in Pittsboro?

Santa takes free photos at the MOSAIC holiday evening on December 5, with the drone show at 7 pm. Fearrington Village hosts Tea with Santa on December 6, which is priced at $125 per person on the visitors calendar and requires a reservation, so book ahead.
